ProcessTimeline.heading: Our Proven Recruitment Workflow
ProcessTimeline.description: A streamlined 4-step recruitment pipeline ensuring speed, accuracy, and full regulatory compliance.
ProcessTimeline.step1Desc: Employer submits demand letter, job specifications, salary structure, and visa quotas.
ProcessTimeline.step2Desc: Candidates are shortlisted, interviewed, and skill-tested at government-certified centers.
ProcessTimeline.step3Desc: GAMCA medical clearance, BMET smart card issuance, and UAE employment visa stamping.
ProcessTimeline.step4Desc: Cultural orientation, flight booking, and smooth airport reception by our Dubai team.
